name: Renée Deborah Schicker
description: Researcher whose 2010 master's work concerned natural hazards.
story: In 2010, Renée Deborah Schicker completed MSc research at University of Waikato titled “Quantitative landslide susceptibility assessment of the Waikato region using GIS”. The Waikato research compared weights-of-evidence and logistic-regression approaches to landslide susceptibility using terrain, geology, rainfall, land cover and other mapped predictors.
